english.title: Drivers hours - cause driver to fail to take minimum weekly rest period
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), being the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), not to have a minimum weekly rest period of

(A)_[45]_
(B)_[36]_
(C)_[24]_

consecutive hours during the week ending 24.00 hours on **(..SPECIFY DATE AT END OF PERIOD..) in contravention of Article 8(3) of the Community Drivers' Hours Regulations
english.legislation: Contrary to section 96(11A) of the Transport Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
caused a driver of a motor vehicle to fail to take
the minimum weekly rest period of 45/36/24 hours

english.notes:
(i) See Article 8(3) for circumstances in which the weekly rest period may be reduced.
(ii) Where the place of offence is uncertain, section 103(7) provides that the offence may be treated as having been committed at the place of driving, the person's place of residence or the principal place of business.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) See also offence wordings at H2615 and H2617.
